description: This file defines the PoStreamReader class, which implements a stream reader for gettext PO files, parsing their content according to the gettext PO file format. It manages reading, parsing, and storing PO file entries, headers, and errors.

classes.name: PoStreamReader
classes.description: A class that reads and parses gettext PO files as a stream, maintaining internal state and handling errors.

methods.name: getLangcode
methods.description: Returns the language code of the PO stream.

methods.name: setLangcode
methods.description: Sets the language code for the PO stream.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Returns the header of the PO file.

methods.name: setHeader
methods.description: Sets the header of the PO file (not implemented).

methods.name: getURI
methods.description: Returns the URI of the PO stream.

methods.name: setURI
methods.description: Sets the URI of the PO stream.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens the PO stream and reads the header.

methods.name: readItem
methods.description: Reads the next PO item from the stream.

methods.name: setSeek
methods.description: Sets the seek position in the stream.

methods.name: getSeek
methods.description: Gets the current position in the stream.

methods.name: readHeader
methods.description: Reads and processes the header from the PO stream.

methods.name: readLine
methods.description: Reads a line from the stream and updates internal state accordingly.

methods.name: setItemFromArray
methods.description: Converts an array of parsed data into a PoItem object.

methods.name: parseQuoted
methods.description: Parses a quoted string, handling escape characters.

methods.name: shortenComments
methods.description: Creates a short string summary of comment lines.
